title: Start with the Shadow
caption:
Beauty Note — No. 09
Start with the Shadow

Many think of eyeshadow this way:
a light shade all over, then a deeper one to define.

Sometimes, I work the other way around.

In this year's atelierR sessions,
I begin with a soft shade colour,
blended gently across the lid to create depth.
Only then do the defining shade and the main colour follow.

Even the palest, lightest colours keep their dimension.
Nothing looks flat.

No obvious gradient. No visible effort.
Just eyes that look quietly, naturally defined.
